steps.label: RAW
steps.sub: exact, untouched copy of the source — ground truth

steps.label: CLEANSED
steps.sub: typed, validated, deduplicated — same grain as source

steps.label: CURATED
steps.sub: aggregated, business-ready — what a dashboard queries

eyebrow: A concrete example, start to finish
code:
raw/yellow-taxi/.../yellow_tripdata_2024-01.csv
  -- untouched, includes bad rows (negative fares)

cleansed/yellow-taxi/.../part-0000.parquet
  -- bad rows removed, types enforced, Parquet

curated/daily-revenue-by-borough/.../part-0000.parquet
  -- one row per (day, borough) — what the dashboard queries
caption: Row count reshapes from cleansed to curated. Raw never changes, no matter what.

eyebrow: Why raw is genuinely never touched
code:
-- If a cleansing rule turns out to be wrong,
-- raw is still there, complete, ready to reprocess.
--
-- Modify raw "to fix it" and you lose that ability
-- permanently.
